name: MACD Impulse Momentum 1m
code:
class MacdImpulse1m(NoraStrategy):
    """Xung lượng MACD nhanh (8, 17, 9) bắt nhịp sóng đẩy 1 phút."""
    timeframe = "1m"

    macd_fast = 8
    macd_slow = 17
    macd_signal = 9
    stop_loss_pct = 1.1
    take_profit_pct = 0.7
    trailing_stop_pct = 0.0
    trailing_activation_pct = 0.0
    timeout = 45
    risk_per_trade_pct = 1.0

    def on_bar(self):
        macd_line, sig_line, macd_hist = macd(close, self.macd_fast, self.macd_slow, self.macd_signal)
        enter_sig = (macd_line > sig_line) & (macd_hist > 0.0)
        exit_sig = macd_line < sig_line
        self.close(exit_sig)
        self.buy(enter_sig)
note: Chiến lược 1m siêu tốc cho BTC/ETH - Bot #5
